mapper.select: SELECT r.*, e.name AS equipment_name FROM equipment_rental r LEFT JOIN equipment e ON r.equipment_id = e.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment_rental (rental_no, equipment_id, quantity, start_time, end_time, borrower, contact_phone, rental_price, status) VALUES (#{rentalNo}, #{equipmentId}, #{quantity}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{borrower}, #{contactPhone}, #{rentalPrice}, #{status})
